response.sql: SELECT orders.orderflow AS status, AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS num_executions, COUNT(*)::REAL / (SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS fraction_of_all_executions FROM orders INNER JOIN orderexecutions ON orders.recordvault = orderexecutions.ordersmark GROUP BY orders.orderflow ORDER BY orders.orderflow;

assumptions.assumption: "order status" refers to the `orders.orderflow` column, which contains enum values (New, PartiallyFilled, Cancelled, Filled) representing the order status.
